profile.name: 传感器轮询线程
profile.description: 用于实验自动化系统中的非物理软件线程组件，负责在后台周期性轮询传感器读数，并管理读数缓冲区与线程生命周期。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software thread component used in laboratory automation to poll sensor readings in the background and manage the reading buffer and thread lifecycle.
